challenge.immutability_rule: Do not modify challenge-v1.json for an existing replication run. Semantic changes require a new challenge version.

required_behavior: fail closed on challenge digest mismatch
do not compare basis with any target hypothesis

submission_envelope.out_of_challenge_findings: First-class evidence. Missing obligations, domains, distinctions, counterexamples or challenge-bias findings may be added and must be considered during adjudication.

evidence_boundary.structural_verifier_pass: Does not prove semantic adequacy, challenge completeness, independence, Genesis correspondence, minimality or Canon.
evidence_boundary.material_independence: Requires an epistemically separate reconstruction path; R3/R4 additionally require pre-commitment/blinding discipline.
